description: Show the hourly rate for a role as of a date and currency: the row picked is the latest valid_from at or before that date, and the answer names it. With no role given, lists every card. Free.

currency.description: Defaults to the shared business profile's currency

date.description: The day the rate is wanted for, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

role.description: The role, e.g. senior developer. Omit to list every rate card

name: rate_get
title: The hourly rate on a date
